job.title: Key Account Sales Director
job.description:
Sales Director, Key Accounts – Americas (100% Remote / US-Based)
  
Location: United States (100% Remote)
Leadership: Full team management and strategic oversight
  
We have been exclusively retained by an iconic, premium European hardware manufacturer that has spent nearly a century pioneering the global sound and communications industry. Renowned for engineering some of the world's most trusted commercial audio architectures, high-end acoustic systems, and enterprise collaboration technologies, their solutions power environments ranging from corporate boardrooms and higher-education lecture halls to large-scale public venues and broadcast studios.
  
They are seeking a high-caliber Sales Director for Key Accounts (Americas) to take the reins of their regional B2B commercial strategy, spearhead team development, and aggressively expand their enterprise market footprint.
  
If you are a disciplined commercial leader with deep roots in enterprise hardware, networked electronics, or professional technology platforms, this is your opportunity to command a massive territory backed by an elite global brand.
  
The Role (Key Responsibilities)
  
In this executive-level sales leadership position, you will drive the commercial strategy for high-value key accounts across the Americas region:
  
  • Strategic Growth: Architect and deploy high-level commercial strategies to systematically scale revenue, boost profitability, and elevate brand equity within target verticals.
  • People Leadership: Provide direct mentorship, coaching, and performance management to a dedicated team of regional account managers and internal sales support staff.
  • Operational Discipline: Establish rigorous forecasting, pipeline tracking, and sales execution frameworks to guarantee exceptional predictability and accuracy.
  • Global Alignment: Collaborate closely with international executive leadership to synchronize domestic sales initiatives with the brand's long-term global goals.
  
What We’re Looking For
  
  • Experience: 7+ years of successful enterprise sales or project management experience within a technology-driven manufacturing environment (commercial audio, smart building technology, Unified Communications, or advanced hardware ecosystems preferred).
  • Leadership Background: 3+ years explicitly supervising and scaling high-performing sales teams.
  • Business Acumen: Deep market insight, sharp financial competence, and a comprehensive understanding of complex, solution-based technology sales cycles.
  • Core Competencies: Outstanding negotiation skills, stakeholder influence, and a verifiable history of building lasting relationships with Tier-1 accounts.
  • Education: A 4-year University degree in Business or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  
Why Join This Organization?
  
  • Exceptional Culture: Work within a highly supportive, modern, and internationally collaborative family business that genuinely views people and mindset as its greatest assets.
  • Modern Flexibility: Enjoy the autonomy of a 100% remote layout, heavily supported by flexible working models designed for a strong professional-to-personal life balance.
  
How to Apply
  
Positions of this caliber with established global brands do not stay open long in this market.
  
Send a direct message on LinkedIn with your resume or apply to set up a confidential, introductory call.

job.title: Warehouse Operations Manager
job.description:
Take full operational ownership of a fast-paced technical warehouse powering complex, multi-event logistics. This business delivers high-spec production solutions and needs a sharp, systems-driven leader to manage day-to-day depot operations, equipment readiness, inventory accuracy, and multi-truck transport scheduling.
  
The Role
  
Based primarily on-site at a major operational hub, you will bridge the gap between high-level logistics planning and hands-on site execution. You will lead a dedicated warehouse team, establishing clear daily priorities, setting quality control standards, and holding people accountable for flawless prep. Working closely with Project Managers, you will translate complex event specifications into executable gear pulls, identify equipment conflicts early, and manage subrentals to keep margin tight. You will also oversee fleet maintenance, facility safety, physical inventory counts, and senior-level troubleshooting when gear returns from the field.
  
What You Need
  
  • Operations Leadership: 5+ years managing physical logistics, technical depot operations, or rental inventory in a fast-turnaround environment.
  • Systems & Process Driven: Excellent command of inventory tracking systems, asset management, and workflow optimisation.
  • Technical Aptitude: Strong ability to grasp complex technical kit, signal flows, and equipment maintenance (live event/AV sector experience is a massive plus).
  • Hands-On Leadership: A leader who thrives on planning and team management, but isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves when deadlines hit.
  • Requirements: Clean driving licence and full physical capability to handle gear in a busy depot.
  
What Is on Offer
  
A competitive salary package of $90,000–$115,000 dependent on experience, plus comprehensive benefits. You will have genuine autonomy to shape processes, build a high-performing warehouse team, and drive operational excellence within a thriving business.
  
Apply today—this job was brought to you by IN2-AV, specialist Audio Visual recruiters.
